text: Ecology is the science that studies the interaction between organisms and their environment, aiming to reveal how organisms adapt to and influence their environment, as well as the impact of environmental changes on biological populations, communities and ecosystems. It spans multiple scales from micro (such as individual physiological adaptation) to macro (such as global ecosystems), addressing issues like "how organisms survive and reproduce in the environment" and "how ecosystems maintain balance". It is an interdisciplinary subject that connects biology, geography, and environmental science.
